verdict.rationale: The GitHub README says the free open-source SigNoz runs in your own infrastructure via Docker, Kubernetes, or Linux, with full control of the data plane. Community reports of a many-container docker-compose stack confirm the self-hosted deployment is real, if heavy. The pack has no documentation of the architecture or of an upgrade/migration path for self-hosted production, and the 'ee/' licensing comment raises open questions about whether the full feature set is open. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted architecture, documented upgrade path, production-hardening guidance, and hands-on corroboration of production self-hosting.
